title: 🏛️ Exams 2023, 2026 · writing prepared: helping at home, caring for a pet ⭐⭐⭐

questions.prompt: (Exam 2026 — writing, question 2) Task: "One winter day, as you were walking home from school, you saw a little cat in the rain. You decided to take it home. Write a paragraph (6 to 8 sentences) to describe the weather and the cat on that day, and to talk about how you took care of your new pet (write at least 4 actions)." Which plan fits the task?

options.text: The weather and the cat · at least four ways of taking care of it
The weather and the cat · my favourite football team
The weather and the cat · what I will buy at the shop with my mother tomorrow
Only the cat · one way of taking care of it

questions.explanation: The task asks for three things: the weather, the cat, and at least four actions to take care of it. The plans with a football team or a shopping trip add an idea nobody asked for, and the plan with only the cat and one action leaves out the weather and three of the four actions.

questions.prompt: (Exam 2023 — writing, question 2) Task: "It's Sunday. Members of your family decide to do the housework together. Write a short paragraph (4 to 6 sentences) to describe what everyone does. Give four ideas." What must the paragraph do?

options.text: Say what you and your friends did last Sunday when you played in the park.
Say what you will do next Sunday at school with your teacher and your friends.
Say what four people in the family do to help in the house on this Sunday.
Say only what you do yourself, in one long sentence of ten lines.

questions.explanation: The task gives the day, Sunday, the situation, the family doing the housework together, and the number of ideas, four. A good paragraph tells what four members of the family do. Last Sunday in the park and next Sunday at school are other days in other places, and one long sentence about yourself does not describe what everyone does.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023 — writing, question 2)
Your paragraph is about the housework that the family does together on Sunday. Which sentence belongs in it?

options.text: My cousin plays football in a big club in Sfax.
My brother helps by tidying the living room.
The school bus comes at seven o'clock every morning.
I like chocolate cake and orange juice for breakfast.

questions.explanation: The paragraph must say who helps with the housework and what each person does, and tidying the living room is exactly a task of the housework. The football club, the school bus and the breakfast may all be true, but none of them is about the housework, so they do not answer the task.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — writing, question 2)
In your paragraph you tell how you took care of the little cat. Which of these actions can you write?

options.text: give it some milk and water
make a warm bed for it
leave it outside in the rain
dry it with a towel
hit it when it is noisy
take it to the vet

questions.explanation: Giving milk and water, making a warm bed, drying the cat with a towel and taking it to the vet are four ways of taking care of a wet and hungry cat. Leaving it outside in the rain and hitting it do the opposite: they are not care, so they do not answer the task.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023 — writing, question 2)
It's Sunday and the family does the housework together. Mum is in the kitchen, Dad is in the garden, my sister is in the living room with a mop, and I am in my bedroom. Match each person with the task he or she does.

options.text: Mum
Dad
My sister
I
tidy the bed
wash the dishes
mop the floor
water the flowers

questions.explanation: Each task belongs to the place where the person is. Mum is in the kitchen, where the dirty plates are, so she washes the dishes; Dad is in the garden, so he waters the flowers; my sister has a mop in the living room, so she mops the floor; and the speaker is in the bedroom, where the bed is, so the speaker tidies the bed.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — writing, question 2)
The task tells a story about a day that is over: "you saw a little cat in the rain. You decided to take it home." Which sentence starts your paragraph in the right time?

options.text: That winter day, I find a little cat in the rain.
That winter day, I will find a little cat in the rain.
That winter day, I finding a little cat in the rain.
That winter day, I found a little cat in the rain.

questions.explanation: The day is over, so the story is told in the past: the task itself says saw and decided, and found is the past of find. Find on its own is the present, which does not go with That winter day; will find looks forward to a day that has not come; and finding cannot be the only verb of a sentence.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2023 — writing, question 2)
Your paragraph tells what the family does every Sunday, in the present. Which sentence tells it right?

options.text: My grandfather wash the car every Sunday.
My grandfather washes the car every Sunday.
My grandfather is wash the car every Sunday.
My grandfather washing the car every Sunday.

questions.explanation: A habit takes the simple present, and with a singular subject like my grandfather the verb adds -s: washes. The form wash forgets that -s, is wash puts be in front of a bare verb, where be would need an -ing verb, and washing alone has no be in front of it to make a sentence.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — writing, question 2)
You must write a paragraph about the little cat that you found in the rain. Which sentence is the best opening for the paragraph?

options.text: One rainy winter day, I took care of a little cat that I found in the street.
That's why I now love all cats and I want to have one at home with me.
I gave the cat some warm milk in a small blue bowl when we got home.
My brother likes football very much and he plays it with his friends every day.

questions.explanation: The opening sentence announces the whole paragraph: a rainy winter day, a cat found in the street, and the care you gave it. The sentence that starts with That's why is a conclusion, the sentence about the milk is one small action among all the others, and the sentence about a brother and football has nothing to do with the cat.

questions.prompt:
(Exam 2026 — writing, question 2)
Put the sentences of the paragraph about the little cat in the right order.

options.text: That evening, I took it home and put a blanket around it.
The next day, I bought a toy for it.
Now my new pet plays happily in the garden.
One winter day, I saw a little cat in the rain, and it was very wet.
That night, I gave it some fish and fresh water.

questions.explanation: The paragraph follows the time of the story. It opens with the winter day on which the cat is seen, then comes the evening when it is taken home, then the night, the next day and finally now, when the pet is happy at home. Each sentence starts with its own mark of time, and these marks go from the earliest to the latest.
